info.syllabusName: Ảnh hưởng của công nghệ (The Impact of Technology on Entertainment and Media)
info.syllabusEnglish: The Impact of Technology on Entertainment and Media
info.description: This course will briefly introduce each of these industries and examine the impact technology has had on them, including a realistic assessment of possibilities for the future. We will focus on technology’s role as a fundamental driver of strategic change, primarily based on assessing its effect on an individual industry’s value chain and participants in that value chain. The course style will be a PowerPoint-guided lecture, with several guest speakers.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU
